method: Weekly PubMed search for recent peer-reviewed autism research aligned with JourHelp's support, accommodation, sensory, masking, burnout, communication, diagnosis, and quality-of-life goals.

studies.title: Therapeutic Horseback Riding for Youth With Autism and Psychiatric Comorbidities: A Randomized Trial.
studies.authors: Gabriels RL, Peters C, Pan Z et al.
studies.preview: Autism spectrum disorder care is often complicated by co-occurring psychiatric symptoms. Equine-assisted services show promise for improving behavioral outcomes in this population.

studies.title: Longitudinal changes in parent-reported sensory processing from childhood to adolescence in autistic individuals: a long-term follow-up study from Türkiye.
studies.authors: Kaya Evsen S, Kars Kızılkoca S, Huri M
studies.preview: Sensory processing differences are common among autistic individuals and may change across development. However, longitudinal evidence describing how these patterns evolve during the transition from childhood to adolescence remains limited.

studies.preview: This paper investigates whether a Virtual Reality (VR) simulation of sensory overstimulation in a classroom can increase empathy and understanding toward individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) among students aged 13-15 in Danish elementary schools. studies.authors: Sim J, Choi KS, Lee DH
studies.preview: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by restricted and repetitive behaviors and disturbances in social communication and interaction. studies.title: From Signal to Memory: A Proposed Adaptive Hierarchy Linking Autism-Associated Genes to Sensory Homeostasis.
studies.preview: Every nervous system must preserve sensitivity to change while reducing responses to constancy. This review defines that adaptive objective as sensory homeostasis : the process through which familiar information recedes while unexpected or biologically important events remain salient.

studies.title: Considering Autism in Binge-Type Eating Disorders: Broadening Beyond an Anorexia Nervosa-Focused Model.
studies.preview: Research on Autism in eating disorders (EDs) has historically focused on anorexia nervosa (AN), with comparatively limited attention given to binge-type EDs such as bulimia nervosa (BN) and binge eating disorder (BED). studies.title: Sex-Related Specificities of Sensory Profiles in Autism Spectrum Disorder: Impact on Clinical Functioning.
studies.authors: Pezone M, Garotti R, Sgueglia E et al.
studies.preview: Background and Objectives: Sensory anomalies are a distinctive feature of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) individuals and appear to differ in intensity, frequency, and subtype between male and female subjects. According to the diagnostic framework of the DSM-5-TR, these sensory patterns are key clinical indicators.
